task_prompt:
## task_010: Downstream Candidate -- Investor Pitch Email to Nadia Volkov at Nu Ventures

Draft a brief pitch email to Nadia Volkov at Nu Ventures about the Mobile App Launch
for our upcoming Series B investor conversation — focus on product traction and roadmap.
answer:
Subject: Product traction and roadmap ahead of our Series B discussion

Hi Nadia,

Ahead of our Series B conversation, I wanted to share a quick product update. The beta launch was successful, and our Q2 review recorded a 15% improvement in team velocity. We’ve also incorporated findings from 12 user interviews and feedback from our Customer Advisory Board, with reporting features and higher API limits prioritized on the roadmap.

On execution, requirements are finalized and UI/UX work is in progress. We’re targeting an alpha release on July 15, an external TestFlight beta on September 1, App Store submission on November 15, and a public launch on December 20. We’re then planning a v1.1 update, analytics review, and 2027 feature-roadmap work through mid-2027.

Looking forward to discussing the opportunity and roadmap in more detail.

Best,
Alice
